summary: The Big Data Engineer Intern assists in developing and maintaining big data pipelines and platforms while gaining hands-on experience with distributed systems and cloud technologies.
responsibilities: Assist in building and maintaining data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows
Work with structured and unstructured data sources
Support testing, debugging, and documentation of data solutions
Learn and apply big data technologies like Hadoop, Spark, and Kafka
Collaborate with senior engineers on data platform projects

education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data
No prior work experience required; internships or projects are a plus

skills_required.name: Basic programming skills (Python, Java, or Scala)
Understanding of SQL and relational databases
Interest in distributed systems, cloud platforms, and big data
